categories.statement: Gold documents with prefilter_should_pass that this run dropped: 0. Prefilter recall on this development report is 1.0. The 0.90 threshold was not lowered, and the prefilter ruleset was not edited.

End-to-end relevance false positives: 1 (google_support-8c6ab430fbee). Development precision is 0.8571428571428571 against 0.85. The threshold was not lowered and gold labels were not changed to match the model.
End-to-end relevance false negatives: 0. Development recall is 1.0 against 0.80. A prefilter drop counts as predicted not-relevant. Non-ok technical states stay excluded.

Core versus adjacent disagreements, both still relevant: 2 (google_support-2a080da4b930: gold core_incomplete_recall, predicted adjacent_known_item_retrieval, google_support-5b2ec98df32b: gold adjacent_known_item_retrieval, predicted core_incomplete_recall). These do not move the relevance precision or recall gates. Labels were not edited to remove them.

Provider outputs rejected for schema validation: 1 (google_support-8c6ab430fbee). A rejected output is excluded from the accepted-record schema rate and is not a successful validation. The one-attempt bound was not used to issue a repair or re-extraction call.
Extraction cases withheld by the evidence gate: 1 (reddit-c2c00b25a88b). The gate kept the invalid case out of stored analysis. The gold case stays unmatched, and no span was edited to force a match.

Gold cases without an evidence-overlap match: 2 (reddit-87311c2633df#g01, reddit-c2c00b25a88b#g01). Report coverage is 4 of 6. Unmatched gold cases are not scored as field matches. Gold quotes were not rewritten.
Stored model cases without an evidence-overlap match: 1 (reddit-87311c2633df#c01). A stored case that misses its reference is not semantic approval and was not deleted to raise coverage.

Overall unsupported-inference rate on matched cases is 0.38095238095238093. A verbatim quote does not prove the value is supported. Fields above zero: forgotten_information=1.0, query_strategies=0.5, remembered_cues=0.5, retrieval_trigger=1.0, target_subjects=0.5.

Eligible accepted-empty documents in this development run: 0. extract/v4 replaced the earlier accepted-empty album, Memories, and poodle responses on this measurement. The earlier extract/v3 report was not rewritten. A stored case that does not overlap its reference remains an unmatched-case limitation.

Relevance records excluded for a non-ok technical state: 0. Provider schema rejections are counted in their own category: 1. Evidence-gate rejections are counted in their own category: 1. Other failed extraction documents: 0. These failures stay out of every metric and are not counted as matches.
Independent pre-adjudication pairs: 0. Raw agreement is null and Cohen's kappa is null. One reviewer does not create agreement of zero or one, and no second coder was added.

Official gold is 35 documents and 21 cases, reviewed by Sunayana. The owner closed the former 75-100 labelling volume. These approved labels are the final gold set. No documents were added, and existing labels were not edited.

The consumed holdout measurement remains 5 of 15 reference cases. The separate successor remains 7 of 15 and does not replace that consumed claim. Those seats had prior development exposure. This ledger did not rescore them.

The reported schema validation rate uses this denominator: ok model relevance decisions plus stored accepted extraction cases; technical failures are excluded and reported. It does not establish that 100% of processed provider outputs passed validation.

Unmatched stored cases remain unapproved: reddit-87311c2633df#c01.
